verdict.rationale: Empresa Online publishes a remote, credential-based sign-in menu: Cartão de Cidadão, Chave Móvel Digital (including a passport-linked option for foreign citizens), a professional digital certificate, or EU eIDAS. Founders can also sign the pact digitally inside the platform. The evidence does not show that these credentials are multi-factor, or that obtaining them (e.g., activating a passport-linked Chave Móvel Digital or getting a Cartão de Cidadão PIN) avoids biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN sent by physical mail. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the factors are MFA, documented remote enrollment/activation of the credential without in-person, biometric or mailed-PIN steps, independent or hands-on corroboration of a remote sign-in.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the published sign-in path is credential MFA an authorized human can complete remotely — not biometric liveness, an in-person visit, or a PIN by physical mail
